name: stitch-design-taste
title_zh: 给 AI 看的 UI 审美守则，专治界面一股模板味
tagline_zh: 受够了 AI 生成的中规中矩界面？这份 DESIGN.md 让 Agent 交出有严格字距、非对称布局。
tagline_en: Tired of AI's bland, generic UI? This DESIGN.md makes agents ship strict type, asymmetric layouts, and perpetual.
desc_en: Semantic Design System Skill for Google Stitch. Generates agent-friendly DESIGN.md files that enforce premium, anti-generic UI standards — strict typography, calibrated color, asymmetric layouts, perpetual micro-motion, and hardware-accelerated performance.
why_zh: 把「高级感」拆成可执行的硬规则：字号阶梯、颜色校准、动效频率全量化，Agent 不再靠猜。
why_en: Turns 'premium feel' into hard rules: type scale, color calibration, motion frequency all quantified. Agents stop guessing and.
limit_zh: 只约束视觉风格，不碰交互逻辑与可访问性；只生成 DESIGN.md 规范文档，不产出任何代码或设计稿。
limit_en: Only governs visual style, not interaction logic or accessibility. Outputs DESIGN.md spec only—no code or mockups. Requires an agent workflow that.
title_en: UI taste rules for AI agents, kills generic design
